01

“And in the earth are adjoining plots”

Four explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr, al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib and Saʿīd ibn Jubayr (Q 13:4).

433
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 433: 1: 17

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
433: 1:17. Sufyan, from Layth, from Mujahid, on the words
"And in the earth are adjoining plots": He said, salt flats and a canal (verse 4).
العربية
433: 1: 17 سُفْيَانُ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ في قوله الأرض قطع متجاورات قال سباخ وجدول (الآية 4) .
Edition record 371389 · p. 150Link to report ↗
434
Explanation from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib No. 434: 2: 1

al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib

English
Transmission wording
434: 2:1. Sufyan related to us, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Bara ibn Azib, on the words: He said, [sinwan means] palms growing together, and
"ghayr sinwan" palms growing apart (verse 4).
العربية
434: 2: 1 حدثنا سفيان عن أبي اسحق عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ فِي قوله قال النخل المجتمع وغير صنوان النخل المتفرق (الآية 4) .
Edition record 371389 · p. 150Link to report ↗
435
Report from Mujāhid No. 435: 3: 19

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
435: 3:19. Sufyan, from Layth, from Mujahid, on the words
"watered with one water": He said, with rainwater. He said, and so it is with the children of Adam: a Muslim and a disbeliever, and their father is one.
العربية
435: 3: 19 سُفْيَانُ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ في قوله مع بماء واحد قَالَ بِمَاءِ السَّمَاءِ قَالَ وَكَذَلِكَ تقول بنوا آدَمَ مُسْلِمٌ وَكَافِرٌ وَأَبُوهُمْ وَاحِدٌ.
Edition record 371389 · p. 150Link to report ↗
436
Explanation from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr No. 436: 4: 18

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
436: 4:18. Sufyan, from Ata ibn al-Saib, from Said ibn Jubayr, on His words
"and We make some of them better than others in produce": He said, Persian dates, daqal, and [other] varieties (verse 4).
العربية
436: 4: 18 سفيان عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّايِبِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ سعيد بَعْضَهَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ فِي الأُكُلِ قال فارسي ودقل والوان (الآية 4) .

03

“what the wombs diminish”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and al-Ḍaḥḥāk (Q 13:8).

442
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 442: 10: 8

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
442: 10:8. Sufyan, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
"what the wombs diminish": He said, the flow of blood; "and what they increase": he said, the retention of blood (verse 8).
العربية
442: 10: 8 سفيان عن بن أبي نجيح عن مجاهد تغيض الأرحام قال خروج الدم تزداد قال استمساك الدم (الآية 8) .

Report from al-Ḍaḥḥāk No. 443: 11: 9

al-Ḍaḥḥāk

English
Transmission wording
443: 11:9. Sufyan, from Ibn Jurayj, from al-Dahhak, who said:
The flow of blood within the nine months; "what they increase": he said, whatever is beyond that.
العربية
443: 11: 9 سفيان عن بن جُرَيْجٍ عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ قَالَ خُرُوجُ الدَّمِ مَا بَيْنَ تِسْعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ تزداد قال ما فوق ذلك.
Edition record 371391 · p. 152Link to report ↗

11

“tuba for them”

Two explanations transmitted from Mughith and its side (Q 13:29).

453
Explanation from Mughith No. 453: 21: 14

Mughith

English
Transmission wording
453: 21:14. Sufyan, from al-Amash, from Abu al-Ashras, from Mughith:
"tuba for them": He said, it is a tree in Paradise. If a rider circled it on a young camel or a four-year-old camel, he would not reach the place he set out from until he grew old. And there is no household in Paradise but that a branch of its branches hangs down in ⦗p. 154⦘ its house (verse 29).
العربية
453: 21: 14 سفيان عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي الأَشْرَسِ عن مغيث طوبى لهم قَالَ شَجَرَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لَوْ طاف عليها طايف كل عَلَى بَكْرٍ جِذْعٍ أَوْ حُقٍّ لم يبلغ المكان الذي ارتحل مِنْهُ حَتَّى يَهْرَمَ وَلَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ إِلَّا مدلا فِي ⦗p. 154⦘ بيته غصن من أغصانها (الآية 29) .
Edition record 371392 371393 · pp. 153–154Link to report ↗
454
Report from its side No. 454: 22: 15

its side

English
Transmission wording
454: 22:15. Sufyan, from al-Amash, from Abu al-Ashras, from Mughith: And the bird will please them, and they will eat from its side, roasted and dried; then it will be told,
"Fly," and it will fly.
العربية
454: 22: 15 سفيان عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي الأَشْرَسِ عَنْ مُغِيثٍ فَيُعْجِبُهُمُ الطَّيْرُ فَيَأْكُلُونَ مِنْ جَنْبِهِ شِوَاءً وَقَدِيدًا ثُمَّ يقال له طر فيطير.
